articles.title: GitHub RCE Vulnerability Allows Hackers to Compromise Servers With a Single Git Push Command
articles.summary:
A serious vulnerability in GitHub’s internal Git infrastructure allowed an authenticated user to execute arbitrary commands on the server while processing a single git push. This flaw, identified as CVE-2026-3854, impacted GitHub.com, GitHub Enterprise Cloud, and self-hosted GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES). Wiz Research discovered the issue and reported it through GitHub’s bug bounty program. GitHub […]

articles.summary:

articles.title: Tor Browser 15.0.23 Released With Fixes for Security Bypass Vulnerabilities
articles.summary:

The update also included security patches from Mozilla and upgraded the NoScript extension across all platforms. articles.summary:
